items.summary: Kyverno before 1.19.1 fails to properly validate URL-encoded path segments in the Policy apiCall urlPath, allowing namespace tenants to bypass the per-namespace clamp and create arbitrary objects across the cluster. Patch to 1.19.1 or later.

GitLab remediated a critical issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.7, 19.3 before 19.3.3, and 19.4 before 19.4.1, exploitable remotely without authentication. Upgrade to 19.2.7, 19.3.3, or 19.4.1.

Eval injection in the JScript event-script dispatcher in Progressive Robot Ltd's hMailServer versions 6.0.0 through 6.3.3 on Windows lets a remote, unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary code. Upgrade hMailServer immediately.

Obot, an open-source AI agent/MCP platform, documents a Docker quickstart command that starts an insecure default configuration in all versions up to and including commit d7e6970, exposing users to remote exploitation. Redeploy with a hardened configuration.

Nezha 2.2.3 contains a Host header injection regression in the OAuth2 redirect endpoint: when the optional dashboard_host setting is empty, /api/v1/oauth2/{provider} reflects the attacker-controlled Host header, enabling account-takeover flows. Patch or set dashboard_host explicitly.
